title: The normalized derived square on an injective roof
statement: Let v:Z→X, f:X→S, k:Z→T, g:T→S form a commuting square h:vf=kg. Let φ:F→v_*G, injective resolutions I,J, a nonnegative complex L of injectives on X, a quasi-isomorphism ell:v_*J→L, and beta:I→L satisfying the coefficient augmentation equation be given. Put U=f inverse V for an open V of S, and extend all complexes to integers. Use the raw comparison b_f and b_k [def-weil-pbc-square-resolution-roof-models]. The composite b_f;localHypercohomology(derivedSquareUnitMap φ);localLeray_g;inverseOpenComparison_g;b_k inverse;H^qΓ(U,ell_Z) equals H^qΓ(U,beta_Z). The target b_k uses v inverse U=k inverse(g inverse V), and ell_Z uses mapExtendIso for v_*. No classical module cohomology or restricted-resolution choices occur.

source.place: Tags 01E4, 01FB, 0D5T and 0D5X; the indicated resolution and normalization calculation

proof.text: Extend beta and ell to integer cochains, inserting mapExtendIso for v_*. A map from the degree-zero single complex is determined by its degree-zero component, so the augmentation equation gives a genuine equality of augmented cochain maps. Apply Q and the naturality of unitQ_v. Since Q(J.ι′) and Q(ell_Z) are isomorphisms, categorical cancellation gives the coefficient map as Q(I.ι′);Q(beta_Z);Q(ell_Z) inverse;t.

Sections of ell_Z are a quasi-isomorphism by the proved direct-image resolution acyclicity theorem, since J and L extended by zero are K-injective. Exact evaluation preserves this property, so HΓ(ell_Z) is invertible.

The injective endpoint comparison identifies b_f followed by the derived augmentation with the natural section unit. Naturality of that unit for beta_Z and ell_Z provides the numerator and denominator squares. Substitute the coefficient roof from step 1 and cancel the denominator square.

The normalized-square target cancellation identifies the remaining unit;t;square;Leray;inverse-open;b_k inverse with the identity. Postcompose by HΓ(ell_Z). Associativity and the inverse identities leave HΓ(beta_Z), proving the original formula without changing its statement.

proof_origin.place: Tag 01FB, remark-explain-arrow, for the explicit augmented coefficient roof; Tags 0D5T and 0D5X for the remaining normalized-square unit calculation. Lean proves the coefficient roof and the cancellation/naturality combination.

theorem square_injectiveRoof_action {X S Z T : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (k : Z ⟶ T) (g : T ⟶ S) (v : Z ⟶ X) (h : v ≫ f = k ≫ g)
    (F : X.Modules) (G : Z.Modules) (φ : F ⟶ (pushforward v).obj G)
    (I : InjectiveResolution F) (J : InjectiveResolution G)
    (L : CochainComplex X.Modules ℕ) (hL : ∀ n : ℕ, Injective (L.X n))
    (ell : ((pushforward v).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj J.cocomplex ⟶ L)
    (hell : QuasiIso ell) (beta : I.cocomplex ⟶ L)
    (hbeta : I.ι.f 0 ≫ beta.f 0 = φ ≫ (pushforward v).map (J.ι.f 0) ≫ ell.f 0)
    (q : ℕ) (V : S.Opens) :
    let U := f ⁻¹ᵁ V
    let Γ := (RingedSpace.openModuleSections X.toRingedSpace U).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
    let H := HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (q : ℤ)
    let ellZ := (J.cocomplex.mapExtendIso ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat (pushforward v)).hom ≫
      HomologicalComplex.extendMap ell ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat
    let betaZ := HomologicalComplex.extendMap beta ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat
    (squareInjectiveLocalComparison f F q V I U rfl).hom ≫
      ((RingedSpace.localHypercohomologyPresheaf S.toRingedSpace (q : ℤ)).map
        (derivedSquareUnitMap f k g v h F G φ)).app (op V) ≫
      (RingedSpace.topEdgeLocalLeray g.toLRSHom.toShHom (q : ℤ)
        ((schemeDerivedDirectImage k).obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj G))).hom.app (op V) ≫
      (squareInverseOpenComparison g (q : ℤ)
        ((schemeDerivedDirectImage k).obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj G))).hom.app (op V) ≫
      (squareInjectiveLocalComparison k G q (g ⁻¹ᵁ V) J (v ⁻¹ᵁ U) (by
        rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage, h])).inv ≫
      H.map (Γ.map ellZ) = H.map (Γ.map betaZ)
